description: Takes the role name, level (operativ, strategisch, fuehrung, leitung), categories, approval limit in euros, who it reports to, and activities with a RACI letter each (R does, A is accountable, C is consulted, I is informed). Activities may be named in the user's own words or by number from the KULIC five-stage chain (1 strategy and categories, 2 sourcing and supplier selection, 3 contracts and supplier management, 4 ordering and goods receipt, 5 invoice, payment, master data; 30 activities, for example 2.5 negotiate, 4.3 approve purchase orders, 5.4 release payments). Returns purpose, RACI rows by stage, KPIs, skills, approval rule, segregation-of-duties conflicts (red, amber) and a job advertisement in German and English with a placeholder for what the employer offers. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

activities.description: Rows: activity (own words or chain number such as 2.5) and raci (R, A, C or I).

activity.description: Activity in own words or a chain number such as 2.5.

approval_limit.description: Approval limit per order in euros.

categories.description: Categories the role buys, e.g. packaging and logistics.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de. The job advertisement always comes in German and English.

level.description: Level: operativ (operational), strategisch (strategic), fuehrung (team lead), leitung (head of procurement).

role.description: Role name or job title, e.g. Strategic buyer packaging.
